subject: planner: revert enhance partition prune when comparing partition key with constant of different types (#62769)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: changes are confined to planner range/range-columns partition pruning in `pkg/planner/core/rule_partition_processor.go`, reverting cast-aware pruning (only prunes direct `Column op Constant` again) and updating integration expectations to scan all partitions for mixed-type comparisons. This makes pruning more conservative, reducing risk of incorrect over-pruning/missed rows for cross-type predicates. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` for this file; no follow-up fixes specific to this pruning behavior were found.
